topic: Claude Code Weekly Limits Promotion 2026: Usage Caps for Heavy Users

key_points: Official Anthropic help article on the May 13 - Sep 13, 2026 weekly-limits promotion (+50% weekly Claude Code usage).
Applies automatically to Pro, Max, and Team plans plus legacy seat-based Enterprise users; Free and consumption-based Enterprise excluded.
Increase applies to Claude Code only (CLI, IDE extensions, desktop, web); Claude chat/Cowork limits unchanged.
5-hour session limits are NOT affected by the promotion.
Post-promotion weekly limits return to standard; promotion expires Sep 13 at 11:59 PM PT.
Run /usage in the CLI to view your current, elevated limits.
The 50% temporary boost runs through September 13; on September 14 a PERMANENT 25% raise to standard weekly limits takes effect (Pro, Max, Team, seat-based Enterprise).
Framing is confusing: you keep 25% more than your pre-promotion baseline, but lose ~17% relative to the promo peak (e.g. baseline 100 -> promo 150 -> new standard 125).
Anthropic acknowledged on X: 'Compared to today, this works out to a 17% reduction in weekly limits on Claude Code.'
Weekly allowance is not a fixed prompt count; it varies by conversation length, model choice, tool usage, effort level.
Anthropic hints at more usage changes coming for better visibility and control.
Distinguishes four 'limits' users mix up: usage limit (plan allowance reset by window), context/length limit (use /compact, /clear), rate limit, and credit/spend limit (API).
When you hit a session or weekly limit: wait for reset, switch model (stay on Sonnet, keep Opus for planning), enable extra usage, or upgrade.
Paid subscription usage is shared across Claude surfaces (Claude app + Claude Code); API keys are metered per-token instead.
/usage shows allowance; /cost shows API spend.
Practical workaround for power users: /compact and /clear to trim context rather than burning weekly allowance on long sessions.
Plan matrix (2026): Free $0 (no Claude Code), Pro $20/mo ($17 annual), Max 5x $100/mo, Max 20x $200/mo, Team Standard $25/seat, Team Premium $125/seat, Enterprise $20/seat+usage.
Subscription metering: usage resets weekly plus per five-hour session; exact token counts Anthropic keeps unpublished.
When you exceed the plan limit, you either wait for the reset or get auto-switched to pay-per-token at API rates without warning.
Pro fits light-to-moderate users (few hours/day, Sonnet); heavy Opus users on large repos typically need Max.
Max 5x gives 5x Pro per-session capacity; Max 20x 20x Pro.
Confirmed: since May 13, 2026 weekly Claude Code limits boosted 50% on all paid plans (through Aug 31 in one data point, extended again later).
Plans give multipliers, not token counts: Pro = at least 5x free/session, Max 5x = 5x Pro, Max 20x = 20x Pro, Team standard 1.25x, premium 6.25x.
On May 6, 2026 Anthropic doubled Claude Code five-hour rate limits (Pro/Max/Team/seat Enterprise) and removed peak-hour reductions.
Fable 5 draws from the same weekly pool, capped at 50% of it on Max and premium seats.
Once past a cap: wait for reset, enable usage credits at API rates with a ~$2,000/day cap.

stats.fact: Anthropic's May-Aug 2026 promotion raised Claude Code weekly usage limits by 50% for Pro, Max, Team, and seat-based Enterprise plans, running May 13 through Sep 13, 2026.
The 50% increase applied automatically to eligible accounts with no action required; 5-hour session limits were unaffected by this promotion.
Effective September 14, 2026, Anthropic permanently raised Claude Code standard weekly limits by 25% for Pro, Max, Team, and seat-based Enterprise plans, replacing the 50% promo.
Compared to the 50% promo peak, the new 25% permanent raise is a ~17% reduction in weekly Claude Code limits (baseline 100 -> promo 150 -> new 125).
Claude subscription plans meter usage as a rolling five-hour session limit plus a fixed weekly limit; Anthropic publishes plan multipliers, not token counts.
Plan pricing 2026: Pro $20/mo, Max 5x $100/mo, Max 20x $200/mo; Team Standard $25/seat, Team Premium $125/seat; Free plan does not include Claude Code.
On May 6, 2026 Anthropic doubled Claude Code five-hour rate limits for Pro, Max, Team, and seat-based Enterprise and removed peak-hour reductions.
Users can check their current (elevated or post-promotion) usage limits in the CLI with the /usage command.

angles: The promotion just ended (Sep 13): explain what heavy users lose and the permanent 25% raise they keep, frame the '17% cut vs promo' confusion clearly and honestly.
Practical survival guide: how to stretch weekly limits via /compact, /clear, model-switching (Sonnet for batch, Opus for planning), and off-peak scheduling.
When you hit the cap: wait-for-reset vs enable usage credits (API-rate, ~$2k/day) vs upgrade to Max 5x/20x.
The 2026 timeline narrative: doubling of 5-hour limits (May 6) -> 50% weekly promo (May 13) -> 25% permanent raise (Sep 14).
Which plan fits a heavy user: cost/limit math for Pro vs Max 5x vs Max 20x vs Team Premium.
'Claude Code free week' reality check: there is no free Claude Code; Free plan excludes it entirely.
